notes: FIELDLOOM is a five-voice Web Audio step-sequencer and playable piano studio with synthesized drums, bass, keys and pads, generated reverb/delay, local save, JSON and WAV export; tested in Chromium for load, play/stop, editing, presets, piano and non-silent WAV output (screenshot capture was unavailable). Known limitation: WAV renders the sequencer (4 bars), not live piano performance.
